report.summary: Incremental static analysis avoids full re-indexing via demand-driven computation and fine-grained dependency tracking. Salsa (rust-analyzer) uses memoized queries invalidated by changed files; latency ~10ms per edit. Glean (Facebook) indexes changed files and merges deltas, achieving seconds-latency on large repos. Kythe (Google) constructs a monolithic graph but supports incremental updates via build system integration. Ideal architecture: layered graph with persistent storage, query-based incremental computation, and cross-layer dependency tracking.

handoff.actionable_step: Implement a Salsa-like query system with persistent layer storage and benchmark against full re-indexing on real commit histories.
